methods.statistics: Median of per-process medians for analysis; median of fresh-process startup times. OS file caches were not flushed.
methods.nativeScope: Actual Wails/WebKitGTK production-mode app on a private headless Wayland display; common frozen pending-tree baseline with 21 grammar checks versus 49. Full prose review includes projection, native analysis, required worker resolution, real bounded card rendering and next animation frame; excludes spelling.
methods.nativeInput: DOM actions and CodeMirror keyboard events in the native webview, not hardware input injection. All vaults and XDG directories are disposable and private.
methods.sizes: Separate uninstrumented stripped Linux x86-64 binaries, trimpath, production/webkit2_41; deterministic tar+gzip level 9, not a release installer. No BenchmarkReport instrumentation in either production payload.

comparison.nativeHarper: Official harper-ls, default rules except spelling, Markdown, isolateEnglish=false, delay=0
comparison.figaro: Production native Go adapter; only Harper/FigaroGrammar alerts retained
comparison.scope: Reviewed cases plus mechanically extracted upstream tests; upstream labels are not independently established English truth.

methods.upstreamLabels: Mechanical Rust/Weir extraction from v2.10.0, not independently annotated truth. Discuss has no extracted upstream examples; its independent cases are included.
